title: MSc Data Science
about: Wits University's MSc in Data Science combines coursework and research: one year of each full-time, or part-time over a longer period. Entry requires a relevant Honours degree with at least a 75 percent average. Applications close 30 November.
requirements: Relevant BSc Honours degree or NQF level 8 equivalent
Competitive: priority goes to applicants with stronger academic merit

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "combines coursework and research" → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."
"Data science" (field) → "Improve academic workflows involving writing support, data exploration, note organization, document analysis, and research knowledge management."

"Competitive: priority goes to applicants with stronger academic merit" → "Apply responsible practices for verification, attribution, citation awareness, confidentiality, and academic integrity when using AI in research activities."
